as_told.title: DMTX trials at Imperial College had no serious adverse effects

plain: A researcher named Andrew Gallimore, speaking in 2025 on the show of podcast host Jesse Michels, says that some time after 2015 Imperial College, a university in London, took up research on DMT, a powerful psychedelic substance, and built a much better way of giving it, so that the experience could be stretched to about 30 minutes. He credits earlier work by a man named Chris Timberman, and adds that all the volunteers at Imperial got through the trials with no serious harm. If true, it would mean people could stay in the DMT state long enough to study it properly.
